probe_notes: Seventh run. No dimension-level score changes across all 7 vendors vs 2026-06-08. Doc-only probe throughout. Leaderboard unchanged: Shapeways 88 / PCBWay 65 / JLCPCB 38. Notable surface expansions found this run: (1) JLCPCB API platform now covers 4 services — PCB, Stencil, 3D Printing (SLA/MJF/SLM/FDM/SLS/WJP), and Components/Parts — per help article updated March 25, 2026; api.jlcpcb.com landing page confirms 'automatic quoting, quick ordering, and real-time order tracking' across all four; access still gated behind approved developer review based on order history, score unchanged. (2) PCBWay Help page newly documents group-order endpoints: CheckTGroupOrder, PayTGroupOrder, CancelTGroupOrder, CheckGroupOrder — plus api/Account/QueryBalance (confirms pre-loaded balance model); core five-step flow and payment mechanism unchanged, score unchanged. Shapeways developer portal active and stable — printable/restrictions/rejections DFM fields confirmed, no webhooks, no rate limits. Xometry supplier-only scope stable (Jobs + Offers + Webhooks, all supplier-side). Hubs still returns Protolabs Network landing page only. Protolabs ProDesk remains web-UI-only. Fictiv fictiv.com/api still 404.

instant_quote.notes: POST /models/v1 accepts STL/OBJ/VOX file upload with fileName + uploadScale params. Returns modelId after async processing; pricing retrieved via GET /models/{modelId}/v1 with per-material price fields. Upload-to-price flow confirmed stable this run. Developer portal active.

structured_pricing.notes: Material objects in GET /models/{modelId}/v1 response include 'price' (float, USD), 'markup' (float), 'isActive' (bool) keyed by materialId. defaultMaterialId designated. Fully parseable JSON. Confirmed stable.

api_order.notes: POST /orders/v1 documented: shipping address, items array (modelId + materialId + quantity), paymentMethod: 'credit_card' using card on file, manufacturingSpeed ('Economy'/'Priority'), shippingOption ('Cheapest'/'Fastest'). Returns orderId and productionOrderIds. Full order including payment via API — no browser step required. Developer landing confirms 5% per-transaction fee charged on API-placed orders. Stable.

order_status.notes: GET /orders/{orderId}/v1 returns status (placed/in_production/shipped/cancelled), targetDeliveryDate, shipments array with trackingNumber + trackingLink + carrier. GET /orders/v1 returns summary counts by status. No webhook support documented — confirmed absent this run. Polling-only.

auth_accessibility.notes: OAuth 2.0 self-serve via auth.shapeways.com. Two flows: client_credentials and authorization_code. No approval gate — standard sign-up. Developer portal access confirmed active this run. API access free; 5% per-transaction fee applies to orders placed via API. Stable.

rate_limits.notes: No rate limit documentation found anywhere in public docs. Confirmed absent this run.

dfm_feedback.notes: Model detail response includes 'printable' field; 'restrictions' object with material-specific constraints (restrictionId, restrictionName, restrictionEntityIds); 'rejections' array with reasonTitle, comment, pictureUrl for rejected models. Structured DFM feedback confirmed stable this run.

ttfq_speed.notes: Upload and processing are async — pricing available after model processing completes. No documented SLA. Async implies minutes range. Scoring 3 pts pending live probe confirmation. Stable.

notable_changes: Developer portal confirmed active this run — all endpoints accessible

instant_quote.notes: POST api/Pcb/PcbQuotation — parameter-based synchronous quoting endpoint. POST api/SMT/SMTQuotation — SMT assembly quoting. Both confirmed stable this run. Full endpoint list confirmed: PcbQuotation, PlaceOrder, ConfirmOrder, CheckOrderDetails, GetFreightByOrder, QueryOrderProcess, CancelOrder, plus newly-documented group-order variants (CheckTGroupOrder, PayTGroupOrder, CancelTGroupOrder, CheckGroupOrder).

structured_pricing.notes: Response includes priceList[] with objects containing BuildDays (int), BuildText (string), Express (bool), Standard (bool), Price (decimal). Shipping struct: ShipCost, ShipDays, Weight, IsRas. Fully documented JSON schema. Stable.

api_order.notes: Five-step documented flow: (1) PcbQuotation, (2) PlaceOrder with Gerber file upload, (3) GetFreightByOrder, (4) ConfirmOrder. Payment: 'Pay to Partner' (pre-loaded balance, fully automated) or 'Pay to PCBWay' (returns PCBWayPayUrl — web redirect). New this run: api/Account/QueryBalance endpoint documented, enabling agents to verify balance before order. Full automation requires pre-loaded balance; web redirect fallback limits score to 10. Stable.

order_status.notes: POST api/Pcb/QueryOrderProcess returns AllProcess[] (all fabrication stages) and List[] of completed stages with timestamps. POST api/Pcb/CheckOrderDetails also available. No webhooks documented. Stable.

auth_accessibility.notes: Static API key in 'api-key' header. Access requires emailing anson@pcbway.com with company/business context — API key on request, not self-serve. Auth confirmed via code examples this run (C#/PHP/Java all use api-key header). Stable.

rate_limits.notes: Not publicly documented in partner docs or PDF. Confirmed absent this run.

dfm_feedback.notes: No DFM feedback in API responses. Quote returns price only. DFM checks happen post-order, communicated out-of-band via email. No DFM fields in code examples confirmed this run.

ttfq_speed.notes: PcbQuotation is synchronous — single POST returns price array immediately. Under 1 minute by architecture. Confirmed stable.

notable_changes: Group order endpoints first documented this run: CheckTGroupOrder, PayTGroupOrder, CancelTGroupOrder, CheckGroupOrder — extends PCBWay's panel/batch ordering capability via API
api/Account/QueryBalance newly documented — agents can verify pre-loaded balance before order placement

All described as supporting 'automatic quoting.' Full endpoint spec gated behind approved developer access at api.jlcpcb.com. Scoring 20 on documented capability across four service types.

structured_pricing.notes: Automated pricing confirmed at capability level across all 4 API services but actual JSON response schema fully gated behind approved developer access. Cannot verify structured fields without approved account. Scoring 0 per probe rule: no verifiable citation.

api_order.notes: Order creation endpoints described across PCB, Stencil, and 3D Printing APIs but payment requires JLCPCB wallet balance pre-loaded. Full endpoint spec gated. Cannot confirm automated end-to-end without approved access.

order_status.notes: Described as 'comprehensive order lifecycle management with real-time status tracking' across all 4 APIs. Mechanism (webhook vs polling) not publicly documented. Scoring polling-level (10 pts) pending webhook confirmation. Stable.

auth_accessibility.notes: Three-credential system: app_id + access_key + secret_key with RSA key pair. Application at api.jlcpcb.com — reviewed based on order history and business circumstances. Not all applications approved. Classifies as 'API key on request'. Stable.

rate_limits.notes: Not publicly documented. Gated behind approved access. Stable.

dfm_feedback.notes: JLCDFM exists as a separate tool (jlcdfm.com) — not integrated into API quote response. No public documentation of DFM fields in API responses. Stable.

ttfq_speed.notes: Described as 'real-time' quotations across PCB and 3D Printing APIs. No specific SLA documented. Scoring 3 pts (1 min to 1 hr) — 'real-time' implies async-but-fast rather than human-review-gated. Stable.

notable_changes: API scope expanded to 4 services: PCB + Stencil + 3D Printing (SLA/MJF/SLM/FDM/SLS/WJP) + Components/Parts — per help article updated March 25, 2026. Score unchanged; scope substantially wider than previously documented

headlines: Leaderboard unchanged for seventh consecutive run: Shapeways 88 / PCBWay 65 / JLCPCB 38 — no score movement

JLCPCB quietly expanded: API now covers 4 services (PCB + Stencil + 3D Printing across SLA/MJF/SLM/FDM/SLS/WJP + Components) per March 2026 update — biggest platform scope change found this week, score held at 38 because full spec remains gated
